title: Cell Marker Predictors in Barrett's Esophagus
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to analyze biopsied tissue samples for changes in cells and genes involved in Barrett's Esophagus.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* History of Barrett's esophagus; scheduled for routine upper endoscopy

Exclusion Criteria:

* Under 18 years of age
* Unable to consent on own behalf
study_population: Patients with a history of Barrett's esophagus
